description:
The CT Cranium DICOM scan is already loaded in InVesalius 3. A pulmonologist and a neurologist are reviewing the same scan. You need to produce two different volume rendering visualizations. 

1. Enable the 3D volume rendering (Raycasting) mode.
2. Select an 'Airways' or transparency-based preset to highlight air-filled structures (e.g., 'Airways', 'Airways II').
3. Export a screenshot of this view to '/home/ga/Documents/airway_rendering.png' (use File > Export or the camera icon).
4. Switch to a 'Soft Tissue' or 'Brain' preset (e.g., 'Soft Tissue', 'Brain', 'Soft + Skin') to highlight brain/soft tissue.
5. Export a screenshot of this second view to '/home/ga/Documents/softtissue_rendering.png'.

Both files must be valid PNG images and distinct from each other.
